name: Democratic Republic of the Congo (1966–1971)
description: A blue field with a yellow five-pointed star in the upper hoist and a red diagonal band with broad yellow edges running from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: Modified version of the 1963 flag introduced in 1966 under Mobutu, with a broader yellow-edged red band and the country renamed the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It was replaced in 1971 by the green flag of Zaire with the arm holding a torch. The 2006 constitution returned to a similar design on a sky-blue field.
